name: Build a bunker to survive zombies tycoon
desc:
🛡️ Welcome to Build a Bunker tycoon! 

🧟 The world is overrun by zombies and you are building a bunker to survive. Team up with your friends to help you research the zombies and build the biggest bunker!

💼 Hire researchers to study the zombies  
💰 Sell research to expand your base  
🔫 Eliminate zombies for extra money  
🚗 Use vehicles to deliver research faster!

💻💰Your researchers work offline for you! Make sure to join back to claim your money!

🎮 Play with friends, kill zombies together, and upgrade your base!

⚠️ HOW TO SELL: There are 3 researchers on the map where you can sell research at from your tycoon! Use your vehicle to drive to that location.

💾 Progress autosaves — come back anytime!  
👍 Like the game to support updates and new content!

🔫 Join our group for a free gun! https://www.roblox.com/groups/16114420 💥

scripts.features:
HELLO'_'


✅ Zombies Ahy© Script Features (Final Version)

🔥 Combat Features

🧠 Auto Kill Zombies – Automatically attacks all nearby zombies.

☠️ One-Hit Kill Toggle – Massive damage (9999) per shot.

🧟 Spawn More Zombies – Triples zombie spawn for faster farming.

❄️ Freeze Zombies – Locks all zombies in place.

🎯 TP Zombies to Front – Pulls zombies directly in front of you for easy hits.


🎯 Aimbot & Visuals

🎯 Aimbot (Head Target) – Locks camera to closest zombie's head (does not rotate when idle).

👁️ Zombies ESP – See zombies through walls with red bounding boxes.

📦 Drop ESP + Distance – Cyan outline on drops, includes live distance text.

⚡ Teleport to Closest Airdrop – Instantly move to the nearest loot.


💣 Ammo / Weapon

💥 Infinite Ammo (Patched) – Previously worked on some guns, now patched in latest update. Kept for UI completeness.


🏃 Player Enhancements

🏃 WalkSpeed Slider – Adjustable (16 to 150).

🦘 JumpPower Slider – Adjustable (50 to 200).

🕴️ Infinite Jump – Jump in mid-air endlessly.

☁️ Walk on Air – Hover above ground or obstacles.

🚪 Noclip – Walk through walls and enemy hitboxes.

❤️ God Mode – Automatically restores health on damage.


💰 Stat Editor

💵 Edit Money – Adjust leaderstats.Money value (up to 999,999,999,999,999).

🔪 Edit Kills – Adjust leaderstats.Kills value (up to 999,999,999,999,999).


🧠 UI & Execution

🎛️ Built-in CompilerKiller UI – Toggle with RightAlt, clean & tabbed layout.

🧩 Organized into: Combat, Player, Money, and Kills Tabs.




⚠️ Execution Reminder

> ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Before executing the script, equip a gun (like 1911) or any tool with a FireServer event.
If you don’t have a gun equipped, features like Auto Kill and One Hit will not function properly.
